pages.name: Spanish: Classical, 4.O-O Nd4
pages.notes: Overview and plans 2 and 4 credited Black with the bishop pair, which neither side gives up after 5.Nxd4 Bxd4; plan 1 pushed d4 onto the knight; plan 3 controlled open files that do not exist. Rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Classical, 4.O-O Nd4 5.Bc4
pages.notes: Plan 1 played gxf3 without the ...Nxf3+ that must come first; plan 3 gave White the bishop pair. Rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Classical, 4.O-O Nd4 5.Nxd4 Bxd4
pages.notes: Overview and plan 1 said Black cedes the bishop pair (knights were exchanged); plan 1 pushed d4 onto the bishop. Rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Classical, 4.O-O Nd4 5.Nxd4 Bxd4 6.c3
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed d4 onto the bishop and developed with Nc3 with a pawn on c3. Rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Classical, 4.O-O Nd4 5.Nxd4 Bxd4 6.c3 Bb6
pages.notes: Plan 2 had the b6-bishop pressure e4 and played ...a5-a4 as one route; plan 3 played Be3 and Nbd2-f1-g3 through the d2-pawn and the f1-rook; plan 4 rerouted a b8-knight that has been exchanged; overview named a pin that does not exist. Rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Classical, 4.O-O Nd4 5.Nxd4 Bxd4 6.c3 Bb6 7.d4
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed e4-e5 onto Black's pawn; rewritten around the pressure on e5 and a4. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Classical, 6.c3 Bb6 7.d4 c6 8.Ba4
pages.notes: Plan 1 played Nbd2-f1-g3 with the rook on f1; now after Re1. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Classical, 6.c3 Bb6 7.d4 c6 8.Ba4 d6 9.Na3
pages.notes: Plan 2 developed ...Be7 with no bishop able to reach it and played ...a5-a4 as one route. Rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Classical, Exchange
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed f4-f5 with the f3-knight in the way; plan 2 claimed a queenside majority and an open d-file. Rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Berlin Defense, Anderssen Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 manoeuvred the f3-knight via d2-f1 (it is the b1-knight's route); plan 2 played ...a5-a4 as one route. Rewritten. British spelling.
